name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity for keyboard navigation. This ensures high contrast against any background while keeping the ring visible and unobtrusive. The trade-off is slightly increased visual weight, but it’s necessary for users who rely on focus indicators to navigate efficiently.

name: Reader
text: The 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a white stroke risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on *very* light backgrounds where the white stroke blends into the background, making the ring invisible. A better alternative is a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 75% opacity, ensuring visibility without increasing visual weight. Test this against the WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1 on all background colors to settle the argument.
